raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially assumed that the painting *The Bacchanal of the Andrians* was attributed to Nicolas Poussin without verifying the attribution first. This assumption set the entire investigation on the wrong path, leading to repeated confusion between Titian and Poussin throughout the conversation. The Planner should have prioritized confirming the correct attribution of the painting at the very beginning to clarify whether the artist was Titian (who died in Venice) or Poussin (who died in Rome). This foundational error caused inefficiencies and misdirection in subsequent steps.
